HIT-X

The Ultimate Indie Action Sandbox

Step into the adrenaline-fueled world of HIT-X, a bold and ambitious 3D action game still in development, offering an insane variety of game modes, maps, and chaos-packed missions.  HIT-X puts you in control of a dynamic character with powerful abilities—from driving cars and shooting weapons to ragdoll physics, night vision, and parkour,


🔥 LATEST UPDATE HIGHLIGHTS

New Weapons & Melee System:
Four new weapons plus a brand-new melee combat system featuring the baseball bat. Feel every hit with updated grip animations and impact effects.

New World War Map + Sandbox Mode:
Fight across a chaotic WWII battlefield or unleash unlimited freedom in the new Sandbox Gamemode.

Improved Core Systems:

  • Added stamina system for balanced movement and combat.

  • Upgraded saving system for better reliability.

  • Added performance mode that auto-triggers below 20 FPS.

  • Boosted overall performance across all maps.

Weapon & Combat Enhancements:

  • Fixed grenade throw physics.

  • Improved sniper rifle accuracy and feel.

  • Added new gun sounds for realism.

  • Fixed explosive barrels and tuned explosion behavior.

AI & World Fixes:

  • Fixed zombie glitches, introduced new zombie detection system.

  • Fixed cop system and overall AI response.

  • Overhauled train map and fixed end-of-map glitch.

  • Removed buggy ladders.

Customization & Quality of Life:

  • Added SWAT helmet to dressing menu.

  • Added new sensitivity settings for precise aiming.

  • Fixed split-screen bugs for smoother local play.

Cheat Codes Expanded:
New cheat codes added for even more creative chaos.

  • Good Luck Finding them Out.


🎮 Core Features

  • Dynamic Gameplay: Walk, drive, shoot, kick, dive, and ragdoll your way through chaos.

  • Immersive Mechanics: Use tools like night vision, helmet cam, smoke form, and silenced weapons.

  • Sandbox Variety: Every game mode feels like a new game. Choose your style—stealth, survival, platforming, or all-out war.

🧩 Game Modes

  • City Roaming Chaos: Explore a living city, raid houses, Rob Bank, and survive against cops and SWAT.

  • Zombie Survival: Barricade doors and fight through waves of undead in an urban nightmare.

  • Wild West Duels: Enter dusty towns for tense revolver showdowns and bandit hunts.

  • Train Banditry: Battle bandits on a fast-moving train in a cinematic, non-stop shootout.

  • Parkour Challenges: Jump, run, and climb your way to victory in this parkour-style obstacle mode.

  • NEW – Advanced Parkour Level: Unlocked after beating the first Parkour Challenge, this stage pushes your platforming skills to the limit.

  • Stealth Rescue Mission: Play as a covert agent, sneak into guarded zones, and eliminate enemies silently, and save hostage.

  • Battle in Hell: Step into an infernal battlefield and take on dark demons in brutal close-quarters combat.

  • Party Folder Mission: Steal sensitive intel from a party club and survive a tactical SWAT takedown.


🖥️ Minimum System Requirements

Tested and built on a low-end setup. This game is made to run even on older machines!

  • RAM: 4 GB

  • Storage: 2.5 GB

  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 or equivalent/better

  • CPU: 1.4 GHz Dual-Core

Performance may vary by game mode. Settings are adjustable.

🌍 Expansive Maps & Future Development

From cityscapes to burning hellscapes, zombie-infested streets, wild west towns, vertical parkour towers, and chaotic party clubs—each map in HIT-X is packed with detail, interactivity, and hidden surprises.

This is my first game, and it's still in development. Your feedback truly shapes the future of HIT-X. Expect regular updates, new content, and improvements based on what players love (or fear).

⚔️ HIT-X is a sandbox of action, chaos, and creativity.

Fight how you want. Play how you want. Discover what happens when you push the world to its limits.
Welcome to HIT-X—where imagination meets destruction.
